Title: Disappointing and Uncomfortable - A Regrettable Purchase

I recently purchased this foam mattress, lured in by the positive reviews and enticing product description, but have been thoroughly disappointed by the reality. First off, the mattress did not expand to the promised thickness after unboxing; it fell short by several inches. Despite waiting the recommended 72 hours, the middle part remained depressingly sunken. 

Sleeping on it has been more of a nightmare than a dream. The mattress is described as "medium firm," but it's more akin to an overly soft marshmallow, providing very little support for my back. Consequently, I wake up every morning with new aches and pains—a stark contrast to my old mattress. 

The foam also retains heat excessively, making for an uncomfortably warm sleep, especially during these summer nights. Overall, it's a purchase I regret, as the mattress neither lives up to its promises nor supports a good night's sleep.
